response.message: The remaining mismatch is between saying “I will not summarize” and producing another summary. A heading such as “Start new task” does not establish that a task exists or has begun. Let the available task input—not the need to keep writing—determine whether there is anything to do. If no task is present, a brief statement of that limit is sufficient; no monitoring or preparation claim is needed.
response.rationale: Targets the observed intention-versus-action loop without inventing available work or requesting another reflection.
